mod_list.empty:
No mods found.
Create one, import a .zip archive, or drop it into the “mods” folder and then click ↻.
mod_list.select_prompt: Select a mod in the list on the left.
mod_list.game_path_required: First set the game installation folder in the “Settings” tab so that you can enable or disable a mod.

conflict.title: Mod conflict
conflict.intro: Warning: to enable “{name}”, you must first disable the following active mod(s), because they also modify some of its resources:
conflict.question: Do you want to completely disable the active mod(s)?

mod_list.import_dialog: Choose one or more mod .zip archives to import
mod_list.delete_confirm:
Do you really want to delete the mod “{name}” ({author})?

Its .zip archive will be permanently deleted.
mod_list.delete_confirm_active: This mod is active: it will be disabled first (original files restored).
mod_list.search_help: Search by name. Tips: “by:author” filters on the author, “version:1.2” on the version.

create_mod.name: Mod name *
create_mod.author: Author *
create_mod.saved: The changes to “{name}” have been saved.
create_mod.leave_edit:
Warning: you are editing the mod “{name}”. If you leave this tab, any unsaved changes will be lost.

Are you sure you want to leave?
create_mod.leave_create:
Warning: the information entered for this new mod will be lost if you leave this tab.

Are you sure you want to leave?
create_mod.conflict_intro: Warning: the resources of “{name}” are also modified by the following active mod(s). To save and apply your changes, they must be disabled first:
create_mod.logo_dialog: Choose the image for the icon
create_mod.images_hint: Drag an image to change its order (or select it and use the arrows).
create_mod.row_hint: Double-click a row to choose another file. One file per item.

game_path.title: Game installation folder
game_path.help: Select the Toy Story 2 installation folder: the one that directly contains the “data” folder. It is required to enable or disable mods (not to create them).
game_path.status_valid: ✔ Valid folder: mods can be enabled and disabled.
game_path.status_invalid: ✘ No valid folder set: mods cannot be enabled or disabled.
game_path.invalid_selection: This folder does not contain a “data” subfolder. Choose the game installation folder (the one that contains “data”).

language.title: Preferred language
language.help: Language of the interface (applied immediately). It is also the default language of the mods you create. You can then add translations of the name, description and warning from the “Create a mod” tab. A mod that is not available in your language is shown in English if it contains it, otherwise in its own default language.

errors.invalid_name: The name and the author must contain at least one letter or digit.
errors.bad_image: “{file}” is not a supported image (png, jpg, gif, webp).
errors.duplicate_mod: A mod named “{name}” by “{author}” already exists.
errors.invalid_mod: The archive “{file}” is not a valid mod: mod.json is incomplete or inconsistent.
errors.read_failed: Unable to read “{member}” in the archive “{file}”.
errors.game_path_missing: The game installation folder is not set or is no longer valid (“Settings” tab).
errors.level_folder_missing: Folder not found in the game: {folder}
errors.vanilla_missing: The original file “{file}” cannot be found in mods/_vanilla.
errors.no_metadata: The archive “{file}” does not contain a mod.json file.
errors.invalid_json: The mod.json file in “{file}” is unreadable (invalid JSON).
errors.missing_member: Invalid archive “{file}”: mod.json declares “{member}”, but that file is missing from the archive.
errors.bad_member: Invalid archive “{file}”: “{member}” is not a usable file (folder or excessive size).
errors.default_name_required: The mod name is required in its default language ({language}).
errors.invalid_i18n: Invalid archive “{file}”: the translation file “{member}” is unreadable.
errors.missing_default_language: Invalid archive “{file}”: the translation file for the default language “{language}” is missing.
errors.game_file_missing: The file “{file}” cannot be found in the game folder and there is no backup in mods/_vanilla.
errors.archive_corrupt: The archive “{file}” is damaged and cannot be read: {reason}
errors.already_added: This item already has a file.
errors.no_resource: Add at least one modified resource (with its file).
errors.bad_resource_path: Invalid archive “{file}”: resource {resource} points to “{member}” instead of “{expected}”.

crop.title: Crop the icon
crop.help: Drag the square to choose the visible area, and use the slider to change its size.
